messages:
alistair: heads-up: a customer hit ERR_REQUIRE_ESM when importing our JS SDK in a CJS lambda. stack shows undici import at module scope.
rhea: ugh. we've seen this before. quick fix is to avoid static undici imports. dynamic import at runtime only.
omar: can we ship a tiny getFetch helper in the SDK and update quickstarts? something minimal: check globalThis.fetch -> dynamic import('undici') fallback.
alistair: yep. also recommend making undici an optionalDependency so installs don't force it for edge/browser builds.
rhea: TS note: call out tsconfig lib: ["DOM"] for edge/browser devs so fetch types exist; for node libs suggest using @types/node and/or skipLibCheck if mixing dom and node libs. include example tsconfig in docs.
omar: CJS consumers will still choke on top-level import statements. ship a CJS adapter that exports a promise: getFetch().then(f => f(...)). small code sample in quickstart.
alistair: bundlers can still inline dynamic imports unless the specifier looks dynamic. add an "advanced" section recommending webpackIgnore or a runtime string trick and warn about brittleness.
tools-bot: Created task #2022: "js-sdk: runtime fetch helper + polyfill docs" assigned to alistair.
rhea: I'll draft the blurb and PR with the helper + sample-apps change. include migration note: Node16 users will need to npm i undici or upgrade Node.
alistair: perfect, thanks.
